Gates of Olympus

Photobooth

A throne on a mountaintop, columns around it, clouds at its feet, built on the auditorium stage out of cardboard, bedsheets, batting and paint. The images are concept renders, not photos of a finished set.

Where
The auditorium stage
Budget
DIY, no budget
Must fit
A family of five, fixed camera
Built by
Parent volunteers

The last three years 2023 Haunted Classroom 2024 Ursula's Cave 2025 neutral theme

The set

Reference frames

Build details

The bolt: two layers of cardboard over a dowel, taped edges, gold spray, about 3 by 40 in. The columns: cardboard tubes sponge-painted as marble.

What we build

Columns
Two, 8 ft tall, 12 in round: concrete-form tubes or rolled refrigerator-box cardboard on a 2x2 spine and a plywood foot, boxes for base and capital, sponge-painted marble. Two small ones near the camera from carpet cores. EcoSet, appliance and carpet stores
Urns with olive trees
Two big planters or vases painted stone grey, or cardboard boxes with a rolled rim. Fake olive or ivy branches sprayed grey-green. Thrift, Buy Nothing, Dollar Tree
Throne
A high-back wooden chair, primed and sprayed gold, screwed to the summit deck so it cannot tip. Thrift, Buy Nothing; 2 cans of gold spray
Props
The lightning bolt: two layers of cardboard over a dowel, taped edges, gold, about 3 by 40 in, make two. Gold laurel wreaths and gold ivy garlands for the columns. Cardboard, a dowel, gold spray, Dollar Tree ivy
Mountain top
Built around the three pallets we have: two stacked and one in front as a step, screwed together, decked with plywood so no foot goes through a slat, skinned with cardboard facets, grey with white dry-brushed edges. Pallets in hand; plywood and paint from EcoSet
Mountain details
Flat cardboard peak cutouts, 2 to 3 ft, dark grey, standing at the very front of the stage. A cardboard skirt from the step to the floor. Appliance-store cardboard, grey paint
Clouds
White sheets and tablecloths bunched underneath, quilt batting torn into drifts on top, poly-fil for loft, a fog machine low behind the summit. Parent ask for sheets; 2 to 3 king battings from Buy Nothing or JoAnn
Sky
A hand-painted backdrop from Schmidli, on their stand. The options are at the bottom of this page. Schmidli Backdrops, Lincoln Heights

Other directions we looked at

Two other Greek myths: The Styx and Medusa's Lair.
